string.text: Disassemble hovered items, optional PDA stash coords, tool wear, and attachment scrap.
Disassemble hovered items. Hold mode sweeps across cells (and the stack popup). Same Shift caveat as Drop.
Grant unread stash coords when disassembling PDAs. Double tool wear if a coord is found, triple if PDA was encrypted. Shows a lock icon on encrypted PDAs.
When GAMMA wants a tool type, redirects wear to the lowest-condition stack of that type that will still survive (including drag-and-drop). Does not change which tool type is required.
Wear the lowest-condition tool of the required type that will still survive.
Disassemble detached scopes, silencers, launchers, and tac kits into craft parts.
Let you scrap detached weapon attachments into craft parts.
